description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the Plasma Module. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Pulsed Capacitively Coupled Plasma Discharge [Plasma Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Plasma Module (Capacitively Coupled Plasmas): Pulsed Capacitively Coupled Plasma Discharge. Physics interfaces: Plasma, Time Periodic (ptp). Study steps: Time Periodic. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("Plasma_Module/Capacitively_Coupled_Plasmas/pulsed_ccp_discharge") to solve it, comsol_example_info("pulsed_ccp_discharge", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > Plasma Module > Capacitively Coupled Plasmas > pulsed ccp discharge

parameters.name: ptp
parameters.description: physics interface Plasma, Time Periodic (API type ColdPlasmaTimePeriodic)

tools.notes: Library path Plasma_Module/Capacitively_Coupled_Plasmas/pulsed_ccp_discharge; model file 0.8 MB. Documented Java build script available (rebuild with comsol_run_example method='java'). Requires the module licence to open and solve.

tools.name: Thermal Plasma [Plasma Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Plasma Module (Inductively Coupled Plasmas): Thermal Plasma. Physics interfaces: Heat Transfer in Fluids (ht), Magnetic Fields (mf), Plasma (plas), Laminar Flow (spf). Multiphysics couplings: ElectronHeatSourceMultiphysicsCoupling, NonIsothermalPlasmaFlowMultiphysicsCoupling, PlasmaConductivityMultiphysicsCoupling. Study steps: Frequency-Transient. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("Plasma_Module/Inductively_Coupled_Plasmas/thermal_plasma") to solve it, comsol_example_info("thermal_plasma", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > Plasma Module > Inductively Coupled Plasmas > thermal plasma
